rules.statement: The right to a decree for ejectment under Section 9(1) of the Rent Restriction Act arises on the subletting and accrues to the landlord at the time of the sub-letting.
rules.supporting_quote: "When does the right to a decree for ejectment under this section arise ? It arises on the subletting. A sub-tenancy continues from month to month; but the subletting is done on a particular day, and it is this act of subletting that gives rise to the right."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 9 (1) of the Rent Restriction Act, Chapter 274
